data.name: Lagos Invasion
data.detailed_description:
A story driven third-person action shooter set in modern day Nigeria, where urban warfare, political conspiracy, and high stakes combat collide.

Step into the role of Captain Adebayo “Bayo”, an elite operative of the National Secret Service (NSS), as you fight to stop coordinated attacks by bandits and expose a deadly conspiracy threatening the nation from within.

 

A Modern African Action Thriller

 

When violent attacks erupt across Lagos, Bayo is deployed to neutralize the threat. What begins as a tactical counter-terror operation quickly escalates into a dangerous hunt for the truth. Powerful political figures, rogue military elements, and a ruthless bandit leader are all connected to a plan designed to destabilize the country.

 

As the evidence mounts, Bayo must operate in the shadows, trusting only a small circle of allies while navigating corruption, betrayal, and escalating violence.

 

 

Combat Under Constant Pressure

 

Engage in fast-paced, over-the-shoulder gunplay where positioning, timing, and awareness decide survival. Enemies push aggressively, forcing you to stay mobile, use cover intelligently, and react quickly as situations escalate without warning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3570 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD equivalent, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-3570 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD equivalent, 8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
